name: WDigest Credential Caching Enabled for Credential Dumping
description: Detects the modification of the 'UseLogonCredential' value for WDigest. Setting this to '1' forces Windows to store logon credentials in memory in cleartext, preparing for credential dumping attacks.

action.description: WDigest 'UseLogonCredential' was set, likely to enable cleartext credential caching in LSASS for subsequent dumping.

operational_usage: This is a very strong indicator of an impending credential dumping attempt. Modern Windows versions have this disabled by default. Any process enabling it requires immediate investigation. Correlate with subsequent access to lsass.exe.
false_positive: Extremely rare. Required only for very specific legacy authentication protocols. In any modern environment, this should be treated as malicious until proven otherwise.
